name: Motorcycle Simulator Connecticut
summary:
Ride Hartford from the seat - alone, or with your friends.

24 KM OF REAL HARTFORD
I-91 north along the Connecticut River past Riverside Park, I-291 east over the Bissell Bridge through South Windsor, then I-84 west through East Hartford and over the Bulkeley Bridge into downtown - the Travelers Tower, the State Capitol's gold dome and the riverfront skyline ahead. Real roads, real bridges, a real city.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
